shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
quadruped with elongated neck/head in profile
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figures in profile organised into horizontal registers, including a row of repeated similar elements and long-necked animal heads, which is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a naturalistic procession of clothed human figures carrying vessels alongside a camel with a floral rosette frieze, while B shows schematic, disembodied animal forms (a crouching predator, a large bird, a snake-like creature) with no human procession, no vessels and no rosettes, and their proportions and outline conventions are quite different.
